description: Modeled Electricity Demand Profiles for Electric Airport Ground Support Equipment in the United States is a data set deposited in DOE National Library of the Rockies (NLR) Repository by its authors Bo Liu, Kevin Robby (National Renewable Energy Laboratory). Electric airport ground support equipment (eGSE) hourly annual (8760) load datasets for the top 50 U.S. airports (by enplanements), as described in Liu et al. (2025). Please cite as: Liu, Bo, Kevin Robby, Jayaraj Rane, Adway Das, Kara Podkaminer, and Brennan Borlaug. 2025. Coverage: national (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 3 files.. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
